damage_type.label: What damage does your weapon do?

power.label: Power Armour
power.note: Power Armour already gives big DR / ER and rad resistance, so those buffs drop down the list. PA users still get carry weight buffs - PA carry weight is low.

none.label: No armour (Berserker's / Unyielding)
none.note: Berserker's does more damage the LOWER your Damage Resistance is, so anything that adds DR (Psycho, Fury, Lead Champagne, DR food) is left out.

bloodied.label: Bloodied (low health)
bloodied.note: Bloodied builds still want Max Health buffs so they can take more hits. Rads are fine (they keep your health low), so rad resistance is left out.

ghoul.label: Ghoul
ghoul.note: Ghouls don't need rad resistance and rads don't hurt them. Chems that also refill your Feral meter get a small bonus.

carry.label: Do you struggle with carry weight?

diet.label: Carnivore, Herbivore or Hybrid?
diet.help: Hybrid dishes are the herb and fruit ones (teas, juices, Sweet Mutfruit Tea...) that Carnivore does NOT cancel - a Herbivore gets them x2 and a Carnivore still gets them at full normal strength.
